materials.content: Pastel on wood pulp laminate board

Pastel on very thick, beige, slightly textured wove paper, affixed to ground wood board
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Bequeathed by the artist to the Art Institute of Chicago, 1987. (Source: Art Institute of Chicago, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. ... No signature. White Shell with background of red hills. Title given by Rosalind Irvine. Note: O'Keeffe think done ab. 1938." Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1938. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1938. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates this as ca. 1938, Art Institute of Chicago dates it as 1938 (without the circa date.) (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* from the Art Institute of Chicago, 2025)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: White Shell with Red

credit_line: Alfred Stieglitz Collection, bequest of Georgia O'Keeffe, 1987.250.2
description: A large, white spiral shell sits at the center of the composition. Behind the shell is a landscape featuring a deep red hill with pink and yellow strips of sky above.
imageCaption: Courtesy of the Art Institute of Chicago.
